name: api-series-challenge
description: ⛔ REFUTED IN PROD 2026-08-30 — DO NOT REPUBLISH. This rule WAS published (user ran `publishCommand` + `publishStep`) and immediately broke the dashboard: every indicator-detail chart, sparkline and Zone-C series went blank while the board itself painted normally. Mechanism: `public/app.js` pulls all history from /api/series via background `fetch()`, and a Vercel bot `challenge` cannot be solved by an XHR — the browser got HTTP 429 + Security-Checkpoint HTML instead of JSON. /api/status and /api/indicators were unchallenged, which is why the outage looked like missing DATA rather than a blocked path. Measured: `x-vercel-mitigated: challenge`, 429, ~2h of blank charts. Removed via `vercel firewall rules remove api-series-challenge` + publish; /api/series verified 200 JSON on a MISS afterwards. ⚠ The prior ruling ('RULED [USER] 2026-08-30: publish it') is REVERSED BY EVIDENCE, and the same refutation kills any challenge/deny action on a path the page's own JS fetches — the uncapped bulk-download exposure returns to ACCEPTED RISK (docs/backlog.md). Background on why this is a CUSTOM rule and not a row in scripts/waf-rules.json: that file's single `rate_limit` rule is 401-blocked on Hobby and is path-set-equality-checked by apply-waf-rules.sh --check on every `make ship`, so adding a path there would have wedged `make ship` at exit 3 forever. NOTHING IN THE REPO PUBLISHES THIS FILE. ⛔ Never delete the live `rate-limit-lab-replay` rule — it is unrecreatable. `publishCommand`/`publishStep` below are kept as PROVENANCE of exactly what was run, not as an invitation. ⚠ `--condition` takes the OBJECT form ONLY, measured 2026-08-30 on vercel CLI 59.10.0 while staging this very rule: the shorthand `path/pre=/api/series` — which an earlier `docs/backlog.md` line and a code review both recorded as the proven syntax — is REJECTED outright (`Error: Invalid condition JSON: "path/pre=/api/series". Expected a JSON object like {"type":"path","op":"pre","value":"/api"}`). That backlog line was a PARAPHRASE of the command, never a literal. Confirmed independently by `vercel firewall rules add --help`, which documents `--condition` as "Condition as JSON" and uses the object form in every example.
publishCommand: npx vercel firewall rules add api-series-challenge --condition '{"type":"path","op":"pre","value":"/api/series"}' --action challenge --yes && npx vercel firewall diff
publishStepNote: DELIBERATELY NOT chained onto publishCommand. `firewall diff` gates only on EXIT CODE, so an && chain would flow a clean-exiting diff straight into a live prod publish with nobody having read it. Run publishCommand, EYEBALL the diff, then run publishStep. To back out instead: `npx vercel firewall discard --yes`.
